title: User function body with top-level case — Tier 4.3 pass-4 item B
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Concurrent assign `y <= decode(sel);` where the user function body is a `case sel is ... end case;` whose arms all `return <literal>;`. Runtime already correct via DeferredUserFunction. Tier 4.3 pass-4 item B: the synth-time inliner accepts a case-terminal body, seeds the running net from the `others` return literal, and wraps each non-others arm in a MUX cell whose selector is `BuildChoiceCompare(sel, choice_literal)` (shared with the process-side `HandleCase` path so VHDL-2008 `case?` matching keeps its uniform behaviour). Bench passes on VCD equality regardless of which synth path took hold; the inlining is verified separately via the schematic viewer / audit-synth.
